model.name: gpt-oss-120b (agent)
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (117B, 5.1B active), MXFP4 as released; the larger sibling of the approved 20b. Fits one 80 GB card. Measured on 2026-09-26 with the original harness (eval/RESULTS.md): same answers as the 20b on the twelve original questions, more than twice the GPU time per question, and no wrong draft on the stripped catalog where the 20b made one.

answers.sql:
SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY txn_cnt DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT d_jur.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.dsply_nm
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT dbr.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON f.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dbr.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON fd.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
WHERE fd.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dc.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.BUS_ID AS market_id,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
       SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d ON f.MKT_K = d.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT d.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON a.BR_K = d.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY d.CTY_NM
ORDER BY d.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_bal
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D bal
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON bal.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE  IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP  BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER  BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND (t.ACCT_TXN_F_K IS NULL OR d.DT_K IS NULL);

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE  f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC;

SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(faf.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE AS faf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS dch ON faf.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS ddt ON faf.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS account_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT dlp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(fl.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fl.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dlp ON fl.LN_PRD_K = dlp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND dlp.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dlp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dlp.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dbr.rgn_cd1 AS region_code,
       dbr.dsply_nm AS branch_name,

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.bus_dt_k = ddt.dt_k
WHERE ddt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY dbr.rgn_cd1, dbr.dsply_nm
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dbr.rgn_cd1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1;

SELECT dmr.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fca.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fca
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dmr ON fca.MRCH_K = dmr.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fca.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dmr.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
       SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.cust_k = d.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d.is_curr = true
GROUP BY d.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR
WHERE dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd) AS weekend_cnt,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.is_wknd) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.ACCT_K) AS account_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON a2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT;

SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND ct.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY avg_days_to_resolution DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_changed_segment FROM (
  SELECT cur.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cur
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev ON prev.BUS_ID = cur.BUS_ID
    AND prev.VRSN_NBR = cur.VRSN_NBR - 1
    AND prev.IS_CURR = FALSE
  WHERE cur.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT ft.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND ft.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ft.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
) AS q

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), wires_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d202
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d202.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wires_2025 w WHERE w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cur.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D cur
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT cur_dt ON cur.BUS_DT_K = cur_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fut ON cur.LN_ID = fut.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT fut_dt ON fut.BUS_DT_K = fut_dt.DT_K
WHERE cur_dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
  AND cur.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND fut_dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND fut.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE ch.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
  100.0 * ( (MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE yr=2025)) - (MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE yr=2024)) ) / NULLIF(MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE yr=2024),0) AS pct_growth
FROM txn;

WITH month_last AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         MAX(b.BUS_DT_K) AS max_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON b.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT ml.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       SUM(b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_last ml
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b ON b.BUS_DT_K = ml.max_bus_dt_k
GROUP BY ml.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ml.MTH_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
), cust_cur AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), ranked AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
         c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
         w.total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY w.total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM wr w
  JOIN cust_cur c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
)
SELECT segment_code, customer_business_id, total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amt DESC;

SELECT ft.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percent_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ft.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY percent_of_total DESC;

SELECT d.mth_nbr,
       COUNT(*) AS month_cnt,
       SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.mth_nbr) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY d.mth_nbr;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fwr.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN fwr.ORGNL_AMT ELSE fwr.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND fx.CCY_CD1 = fwr.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.PMT_STS_CD1, d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MTH_NBR,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1='DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM auth
GROUP BY MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR,
       f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fat
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL dch ON fat.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT dbr.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dbr.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH month_end AS (
  SELECT MAX(dt.dt_k) AS dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  WHERE dt.mth_nbr = 8 AND dt.is_mth_end
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dl.cust_k) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dl
JOIN month_end me ON dl.bus_dt_k = me.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON dl.cust_k = c.cust_k AND c.is_curr
WHERE dl.dflt_flg = TRUE;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       fx.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(fx.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, fx.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY fx.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d_mkt.dsPLY_nm AS market_name,
       SUM(f_ptf_val_d.mkt_val1_amt) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f_ptf_val_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d_mkt ON f_ptf_val_d.mkt_k = d_mkt.mkt_k AND d_mkt.is_curr = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ptf_val_d.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01'::date AND '2025-12-31'::date
GROUP BY d_mkt.dsPLY_nm
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT dbr.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ddt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY dbr.CTY_NM
ORDER BY dbr.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D bal
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON bal.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND t.ACCT_TXN_F_K IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01'::date AND '2025-12-31'::date

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_2025 DESC;

SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(fact.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fact
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL dch ON fact.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fact.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE ch.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT dlp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(fl.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fl.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dlp ON fl.LN_PRD_K = dlp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND dlp.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dlp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dlp.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn AS (
 SELECT dbr.rgn_cd1, dbr.dsply_nm, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
 FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.bus_dt_k = ddt.dt_k
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.br_k = dbr.br_k
 WHERE ddt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
 GROUP BY dbr.rgn_cd1, dbr.dsply_nm
)
SELECT rgn_cd1, dsply_nm, txn_cnt
FROM (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rgn_cd1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
 FROM txn
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT mr.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH mr ON a.MRCH_K = mr.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY mr.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
       SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.cust_k = d.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d.is_curr = true
GROUP BY d.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K AND dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       AVG(ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY avg_customer_lifetime_value DESC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.ACCT_K) AS acct_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON a2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       AVG(DATE_PART('day', f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY d.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cur.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cur
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev
  ON cur.BUS_ID = prev.BUS_ID
 AND prev.VRSN_NBR = cur.VRSN_NBR - 1
WHERE cur.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_2025 FROM (
  SELECT dc.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fat
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dt.DT_K = fat.BUS_DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON dc.CUST_K = fat.CUST_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND dc.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY dc.BUS_ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON dsp.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    WHERE wr.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
      AND dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d0.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d0
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt0 ON d0.BUS_DT_K = dt0.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d1 ON d0.LN_ID = d1.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt1 ON d1.BUS_DT_K = dt1.DT_K
WHERE dt0.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
  AND dt1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND d0.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d1.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.stlm_amt) AS median_amt,
       f.ccy_cd1 AS currency_code
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY f.ccy_cd1
ORDER BY f.ccy_cd1;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON a.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile%App%'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (t2025.txn_cnt - t2024.txn_cnt) / NULLIF(t2024.txn_cnt,0), 2) AS pct_growth
FROM txn_counts t2024
JOIN txn_counts t2025 ON t2025.year = 2025 AND t2024.year = 2024;

WITH month_end AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K,
         d.CAL_DT,
         d.MTH_NBR AS month_num,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_DT DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
)
SELECT me.month_num,
       SUM(b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_end me
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b ON b.BUS_DT_K = me.DT_K
WHERE me.rn = 1
GROUP BY me.month_num
ORDER BY me.month_num;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.CUST_SNC_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH agg AS (
 SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, d.BUS_ID AS cust_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
 WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
   AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
 GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
 SELECT segment, cust_id, total_amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
 FROM agg
)
SELECT segment, cust_id, total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

SELECT ft.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ft.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY percent_of_total DESC;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR as month,
         COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT month,
       cnt as wire_transfer_count,
       SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month) as running_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fwr.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN fwr.ORGNL_AMT ELSE fwr.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND fwr.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.mth_nbr AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.pmt_sts_cd1 = 'DECLINED')::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100 AS decline_share
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY decline_share DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY txn_cnt DESC;

SELECT d_jur.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.dsply_nm
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT dbr.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON f.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dbr.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31';

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d_mkt.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
       SUM(f_ptf_val.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f_ptf_val
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d_mkt ON f_ptf_val.MKT_K = d_mkt.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ptf_val.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_mkt.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d_mkt.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR
  AND OPND_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY accounts_opened_2025 DESC;

SELECT dbr.cty_nm AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fatm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fatm.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fatm.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ddt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY dbr.cty_nm
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D bal
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON bal.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE  IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP  BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER  BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d WHERE d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND t.ACCT_TXN_F_K IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ct.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(fact.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fact
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL dch ON fact.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fact.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY jurisdiction_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile%App%'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT dlp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(fl.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fl.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dlp ON fl.LN_PRD_K = dlp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND dlp.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dlp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_cnt FROM (
  SELECT br.rgn_cd1 AS region_code,
         br.dsply_nm AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.rgn_cd1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.br_k = br.br_k
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
  WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  GROUP BY br.rgn_cd1, br.dsply_nm
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT d_mrch.mrch_ctg_cd1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(f_cd_auth.orgnl_amt) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f_cd_auth
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d_mrch ON f_cd_auth.mrch_k = d_mrch.mrch_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_cd_auth.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d_mrch.mrch_ctg_cd1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
       SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.cust_k = d.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wc
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at ON wc.CUST_K = at.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_wc ON wc.BUS_DT_K = d_wc.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_at ON at.BUS_DT_K = d_at.DT_K
WHERE d_wc.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_at.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       AVG(d.ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY avg_customer_lifetime_value DESC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_K) AS account_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON b.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9;

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND f.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT cur.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cur
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev ON prev.BUS_ID = cur.BUS_ID
    AND prev.IS_CURR = FALSE
    AND prev.VRSN_NBR = (
      SELECT MAX(VRSN_NBR) FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST p2
      WHERE p2.BUS_ID = cur.BUS_ID AND p2.IS_CURR = FALSE
    )
  WHERE cur.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT ft.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND ft.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ft.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT ds
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ds.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON ds.CUST_K = d.CUST_K AND d.IS_CURR
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ds.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    WHERE wt.CUST_K = ds.CUST_K
      AND dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d2024
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2024 ON d2024.BUS_DT_K = dt2024.DT_K AND dt2024.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d2025 ON d2025.LN_ID = d2024.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2025 ON d2025.BUS_DT_K = dt2025.DT_K AND dt2025.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
WHERE d2024.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d2025.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT ROUND(((t2025.txn_cnt - t2024.txn_cnt)::numeric / t2024.txn_cnt) * 100, 2) AS pct_growth
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2024
    AND c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile%'
) t2024,
(
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile%'
) t2025;

WITH month_last AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR, MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT ml.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       SUM(ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_last ml
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab ON ab.BUS_DT_K = (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d2 WHERE d2.CAL_DT = ml.last_dt LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY ml.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ml.MTH_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH agg AS (
 SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
 WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
   AND dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
 GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
 FROM agg
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
       BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
       total_amt AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn;

SELECT ft.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percent_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ft.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY percent_of_total DESC;

SELECT d.mth_nbr,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt,
       SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.mth_nbr) AS running_total_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY d.mth_nbr

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fwr.ORGNL_CCY_CD1='EUR' THEN fwr.ORGNL_AMT ELSE fwr.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND fwr.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR';

SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1='DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100 AS decline_share
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K=d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY decline_share DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR,
       f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1;
